speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; to help me understand your condition, how long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The one-year duration and progression of left-sided tremors are concerning; is the tremor present at rest or only when he attempts to perform a task like holding a cup? Also, have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in his movements?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease.

The combination of a resting tremor, soft speech, reduced facial expressions (hypomimia), and cognitive decline with memory issues strongly suggests Parkinson's disease, potentially with early dementia. Given the significant memory decline and financial management difficulties, I request an MRI to rule out other causes and assess for atypical parkinsonism or neurodegenerative changes.
